observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor living room with tiled floor, white walls, and sheer curtains
observation.formation_and_space: stationary solo dancer performing within a limited floor space in front of a window
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weight shifting from foot to foot
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping, stomping and shifting weight on the beat, feet mostly staying close to the floor
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held up with elbows bent, hands moving in expressive gestures and circular wrist rolls
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle torso sways and hip movements accompanying the footwork and arm gestures
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent full spins and turns on the spot, maintaining a single level without jumps
observation.costume_and_props: gold sleeveless top, bright pink pleated skirt with gold trim, and a sheer pink dupatta draped over the shoulder; no props visible
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid percussion articulation are obscured by low video resolution and fixed camera angle

signature_moments.what: rhythmic foot stomping with arms raised and bent at the elbows, framing the face and head
spinning around in a complete circle while maintaining raised arm positions
pivoting and spinning on the spot with flowing skirt movement
